newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-RONALDO GIVES BARCELONA HALFTIME LEAD OVER PSG.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RONALDO GIVES BARCELONA HALFTIME LEAD OVER PSG.

text.p: A penalty by Brazilian striker Ronaldo gave Barcelona a 1-0 lead over holders Paris St Germain at half time in the European Cup Winners' Cup final on Wednesday.
A rash challenge from PSG defender Bruno N'Gotty on Ronaldo in the 37th minute saw the Brazilian step up for the spot kick.

Ignoring a firework launched by the French fans and dispelling memories of a penalty miss against Real Madrid on Sunday, Ronaldo wrong-footed PSG goalkeeper Bernard Lama for his 33rd goal of the season.

Barcelona created more chances and after 27 minutes had a fine headed goal from Portuguese defender Fernando Couto disallowed after a Gheorghe Popescu foul on midfielder Benoit Cauet in the goalmouth melee.
PSG had the initial run of the ball but could rarely thread it through a tight Barcelona defence. Leonardo's wayward blast after 33 minutes was their best chance.
